inspect_data.doc: summarise observations: splits, sample counts, missing samples, ranges, sigma

optimize_parameters.doc: weighted least-squares fit on the train split (multistart within bounds)

args.loss: one of ['linear', 'soft_l1', 'huber', 'cauchy', 'arctan'], optional (robust losses resist outliers)

analyze_sensitivity.doc: log-parameter Jacobian SVD at the current fit; names non-identifiable combinations

rank_experiments.doc: score catalog experiments by Fisher information added at the current fit

request_experiment.doc: run (or propose) one catalog experiment; its data joins the train split

compare_models.doc: fit every model variant (e.g. with a constant sensor bias) and compare by BIC

args.adopt: boolean, optional, default true: switch to the best variant

validate_predictions.doc: chi2/N of the current fit on the validation split

stop.doc: finish; the code checks the claim against validation and the identifiability rule

args.identified: list of parameter names you claim are uniquely identified, optional
